name: Conquista de la Sierra (Spain)
description: White field within a broad green border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Conquista de la Sierra (a grille and a tree on white, with the date A.D. 1629).
history: The arms and the flag of Conquista de la Sierra were approved by the Order of 18 July 1996 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 13 August 1996, after the municipal council's approval on 27 January 1996.

features.role: Conquista de la Sierra arms — grille and tree, dated 1629
